name: osteria-del-borgo-demo
description: Case study di una trattoria italiana fittizia: Qwik City SSR su Cloudflare Pages

scripts.build.server: qwik check-client src dist && vite build -c adapters/cloudflare-pages/vite.config.ts
scripts.fmt: prettier --write src adapters tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md docs/CASE_STUDY.md docs/WORKLOG.md docs/ASSETS.md docs/BRAND_DIRECTION.md
scripts.fmt.check: prettier --check src adapters tests vite.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json wrangler.jsonc README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md docs/CASE_STUDY.md docs/WORKLOG.md docs/ASSETS.md docs/BRAND_DIRECTION.md
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:ssr
